rules.name: Mandatory Loan ID
rules.description: Each record must have a non-empty, non-null loan ID identifier.

rules.name: Unique Loan ID
rules.description: Loan ID must be strictly unique across the portfolio tape.

rules.name: Borrower & Principal Duplicate Check
rules.description: Flags duplicate loans sharing same borrower ID, principal balance, and origination date.

rules.name: ISO-8601 Date Format Validation
rules.description: Dates must adhere strictly to standard YYYY-MM-DD format.

rules.name: Maturity Date Sequence
rules.description: Maturity date must occur strictly after the origination date.

rules.name: Non-Negative Balance Rule
rules.description: Original principal and current balance cannot be negative numbers.

rules.name: Balance Exceeds Principal Bound
rules.description: Current balance cannot exceed original principal without an authorized negative amortization rider.

rules.name: Interest Rate Bounds
rules.description: Interest rate must fall between 0.0% and 36.0% statutory maximum.

rules.name: Payment Status vs. DPD Consistency
rules.description: Days past due must logically correspond with the designated payment status classification.

rules.name: Document Availability
rules.description: Required promissory notes and deeds of trust must be present in the document manifest.

rules.name: Cross-Source Servicer Conflict
rules.description: Balances and payment statuses in the primary tape must reconcile with the second-source servicer update.

rules.name: Data Staleness Threshold
rules.description: Records updated more than 180 days ago are flagged as stale.

rules.name: Valid US State Code
rules.description: Borrower state must be a valid 2-letter US postal state/territory abbreviation.

rules.name: Paid-Off Loan Balance Integrity
rules.description: Loans designated as PAID_OFF or CLOSED must carry a $0.00 current balance.
